info.name: DMoney - End-to-End Money Flow
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for the DMoney transaction API: register & activate users, SYSTEM top-up of an agent, agent deposit, send money, cash-out and merchant payment — every step has positive and negative test cases, with fee/commission assertions.

30 test cases (one request + one `pm.test` each, several assertions per test). Run the folders in order; each run generates fresh users.

Business rules: dmoney-web-react/README.md (BRD §7–§9). Swagger: {{base_url}}/api-docs/user and {{base_url}}/api-docs/transaction.

item.name: 5. Agent deposits to Customer
item.description: Agent cash-in of 2000 Tk to Customer 1 with the 2.5% agent commission asserted, plus below-minimum and insufficient-balance negatives.

item.name: TC19 - Agent deposits 2000 Tk to Customer 1 — assert commission

exec: pm.test("TC19 - Agent deposits 2000 Tk to Customer 1 — assert commission", () => {

request.description: Agent commission = amount × 2.5% = **50 Tk**. Agent net balance = 5000 − 2000 + 50 = **3050**.

originalRequest.description: Agent commission = amount × 2.5% = **50 Tk**. Agent net balance = 5000 − 2000 + 50 = **3050**.

item.name: 7. Cash-out
item.description: Customer 2 cashes out 500 Tk via the Agent with the service fee asserted, plus wrong-recipient and below-minimum negatives.

item.name: TC25 - Customer 2 cashes out 500 Tk via the Agent — assert service fee

exec: pm.test("TC25 - Customer 2 cashes out 500 Tk via the Agent — assert service fee", () => {

request.description: Withdraw fee = max(1% of amount, 5 Tk) = **5 Tk** for 500 Tk. Customer 2 balance = 1000 − 500 − 5 = **495**. A follow-up balance lookup confirms the Agent earned its 2.5% commission: 3050 + 500 + 12.5 = **3562.5**.

originalRequest.description: Withdraw fee = max(1% of amount, 5 Tk) = **5 Tk** for 500 Tk. Customer 2 balance = 1000 − 500 − 5 = **495**. A follow-up balance lookup confirms the Agent earned its 2.5% commission: 3050 + 500 + 12.5 = **3562.5**.

item.description: Customer 2 pays 400 Tk to the Merchant, plus wrong-recipient and insufficient-balance negatives.

item.name: TC28 - Customer 2 pays 400 Tk to the Merchant

exec: pm.test("TC28 - Customer 2 pays 400 Tk to the Merchant", () => {
pm.expect(res.json().user.balance, 'merchant received at least the paid amount').to.be.at.least(400);

request.description: Payment fee = max(1% of 400, 5 Tk) = **5 Tk**. Customer 2 balance = 495 − 400 − 5 = **90**. A follow-up lookup confirms the Merchant received the money (at least 400 Tk).

response.name: 200 OK

originalRequest.description: Payment fee = max(1% of 400, 5 Tk) = **5 Tk**. Customer 2 balance = 495 − 400 − 5 = **90**. A follow-up lookup confirms the Merchant received the money (at least 400 Tk).
